meta.name: n8n-crm-automation
meta.description: Build CRM automations with n8n for HubSpot, Salesforce, lead routing, and Slack notifications. Use when the user asks about n8n CRM integration, n8n HubSpot workflows, n8n Salesforce sync, lead routing in n8n, Slack notifications from n8n, or pipeline reporting. Triggers on "n8n HubSpot", "n8n Salesforce", "n8n CRM", "lead routing n8n", "n8n Slack", "pipeline report n8n", "deal stage n8n". Do NOT use for Clay integration (use clay-integration).

copy.tagline: 用 n8n 自动同步 CRM 数据并发送通知
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要手动在 CRM 和沟通工具之间来回搬运信息。
copy.tagline_en: Automate CRM workflows with n8n for HubSpot, Salesforce, and Slack.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you frequently manage CRM data across multiple platforms.

howto.what: Claude 可以构建连接 HubSpot、Salesforce、Slack 等工具的 n8n 自动化工作流，包括线索路由、双向同步、阶段变更通知和管道报告。可选地通过 ColdIQ 进行线索丰富和评分。
howto.when: 当用户提到 “n8n HubSpot”、“n8n Salesforce”、“n8n CRM” 等关键词，或要求构建 CRM 自动化流程时触发。

say.text: 帮我用 n8n 搭建 HubSpot 和 Salesforce 的双向同步。
say.note: Claude 会设计一个双向同步工作流。

say.text: 创建每周管道报告并发送到 Slack。
say.note: Claude 会设置定时任务获取数据并发送报告。

say.text: 设置线索路由：根据评分分配给不同销售代表。
say.note: Claude 会构建包含评分和分支的工作流。

howto.what_en: Claude builds n8n automations connecting HubSpot, Salesforce, Slack, and more—for lead routing, sync, stage alerts, and pipeline reports. Optionally enriches/scoring via ColdIQ.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user mentions keywords like "n8n HubSpot", "n8n Salesforce", "n8n CRM", or asks to build CRM automation workflows.

say_en.text: Set up a bidirectional sync between HubSpot and Salesforce using n8n.
Create a weekly pipeline report and send it to Slack.
say_en.note: Claude sets up a cron job to fetch data and post report.

say_en.text: Route leads based on score to the right sales rep.
say_en.note: Claude builds a workflow with scoring and switch nodes.
